betterquesting:10.desc:8:
As the materials around you achieve transcendental properties, pistons and gases stop being enough. The answer is gravity: a black hole, held in a cage of mirrors and coils and spun fast enough that its ergosphere can be put to work.

The §9Kerr Ergosphere Engine§r (KEE) holds the hole and does nothing else: it runs no recipes. The machines that use the hole are the §9Kerr modules§r, separate machines standing in the cage's arcs (next quests).

§5§lMAKE §lIT§r The controller is an §9Assembly Line§r recipe: scan a §9Black Hole Seed§r in the Scanner to research it. NEI shows the rest.

§5§lBUILD§r
- Hologram Projector, stack 1: Kerr T1, 76 × 65 × 71. Chunk-load all of it.
- The Black Hole Compressor's own Extreme Density Space-Bending Casing, Hawking Radiation Realignment Focus and Naquadah Alloy frames, plus Beyond the Stars' Superradiant Mirrors, Mirror Backing, Ergosphere Field Coils, Beam Focusing Quadrupoles, Beam Dumps, Harmonic Lining and 232 Bolt Injector Rails. At the hole's height a §9window band§r runs round the drum: one Quantum Glass pane (the outer mirror ring's skin, and the governor arc in front of the hole) with the cells behind it left open, so the hole shows from the front. The optional task is the full bill.
- Hatches: 1 laser or up to 2 energy hatches in the governor arc, 1 to 8 §9bolt buses§r (plain input buses) on the cage, and optional BHC Utility Hatches beside them. No maintenance hatch.
- Hologram markers 7 and 8 show where the two module controllers go.

§5§lRUN§r Everything is in the GUI.
1. Put a §9Black Hole Seed§r in a bolt bus and press Open: the hole opens at§9 8 SM§r (solar masses).
2. It bleeds mass as Hawking radiation,§9 3.2 / M² SM a tick§r. Small holes die fast.
3. The §9governor§r fires bolts from the bolt buses to hold your §9setpoint§r (2-64 SM at T1):
- Neutronium 1/64 SM, Cosmic Neutronium 1/32, Infinity 1/16, Transcendent Metal 1/8, SpaceTime 1/4 SM a bolt;
- at most 4 / 8 / 16 bolts a tick with Mk I / II / III rails. The §llowest§r rail sets the rate, so upgrade them all together.
4. While open, the hole draws§9 8,388,608 EU/t (1 A UEV)§r of containment. Without power the governor stops; below 2 SM the hole evaporates. The power switch does §lnot§r stop the hole.
5. A §9Black Hole Collapser§r in a bolt bus closes it safely: press Collapse twice.

[note]Mass sets the modules' bonus: a bigger hole gives more parallels, a smaller one more speed. The controller tooltip has the full block list, and NEI's Multiblock tab previews both tiers.[/note]

[note]HOLD → CLAIM → INSTALL: a retrieval task counts only what is in your inventory, and it never takes the items. So keep the part on you, claim the quest, then place it. Every quest that says HOLD → CLAIM → INSTALL works this way.[/note]

§2§lDONE §lWHEN§r you hold the controller (HOLD → CLAIM → INSTALL).

[note]The Black Hole Compressor quest is left as the pack wrote it, because this server has Beyond the Stars' questbook pack edits turned off (a config option).[/note]
